segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: We're bringing you a great elementary podcast today.
segments.zh: 我们今天为您带来一期很棒的初级播客。

segments.en: And we're going to be teaching you how to order pizza.
segments.zh: 我们将教您如何点披萨。

segments.en: Yeah, you know, pizza is one of my favorite foods and the favorite food of many people.
segments.zh: 是的，你知道，披萨是我最喜欢的食物之一，也是许多人最喜欢的食物。

segments.en: It's one of those common foods that you're at home and you want to order something to eat and the typical thing is pizza.
segments.zh: 这是您在家中的常见食物之一，您想点东西吃，典型的东西是披萨。

segments.en: And you know, there's some very special language that you've got to use.
segments.zh: 你知道，你必须使用一些非常特殊的语言。

segments.en: You got to know this language when you want to order a pizza.
segments.zh: 当你想点披萨时，你得懂这些说法。

segments.en: So let's listen to this dialogue for the first time as a man is ordering pizza.
segments.zh: 所以让我们先听第一遍对话，此时一个男人正在点披萨。

segments.en: I'd like a medium pizza with pepperoni, olives and extra cheese.
segments.zh: 我要一个中号披萨，加意大利辣香肠、橄榄和双份奶酪。

segments.en: We have a two for one special on large pizzas.
segments.zh: 我们的大号披萨现在买一送一。

segments.en: Would you like a large pizza instead?
Would you like your second pizza to be the same size as the first?
segments.zh: 您希望您的第二个披萨的大小与第一个相同吗？

segments.en: Make the second one with ham, pineapple and green peppers.
segments.zh: 第二个加火腿、菠萝和青椒。

segments.en: Oh, and make it thin crust.
Your total is 2150 and your order will arrive in 30 minutes or it's free.
segments.zh: 总共二十一美元五十美分，三十分钟送到，超时免单。

segments.en: So I guess he's not getting his pizza.
segments.zh: 所以我猜他没有得到他的披萨。

segments.en: He forgot to give his address.
That's a bit of a problem.
Let's take a look at some of the vocabulary in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看语言要点中的一些词汇。

segments.en: We've got some great pizza words for you today.
segments.zh: 今天我们为您准备了一些很棒的披萨词。

segments.en: And the first one we have is a medium pizza.
segments.zh: 我们拥有的第一个是中等披萨。

segments.en: Usually a medium pizza is 12 inches.
segments.zh: 通常中等大小的披萨是 12 英寸。

segments.en: So you could say, I'd like a 12 inch pizza.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，我想要一个 12 英寸的披萨。

segments.en: For those of us who use centimeters, this would be more or less 30 centimeters.
segments.zh: 对于我们这些习惯用厘米的人来说，这大约是 30 厘米。

segments.en: Let's take a look at the next size, a large pizza.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看下一个尺寸，一个大披萨。

segments.en: So it might also be called an 18 inch.
segments.zh: 所以它也可能被称为18英寸。

segments.en: Or isn't it sometimes called a family size?
segments.zh: 或者有时候不是叫家庭装吗？

segments.en: I guess it depends where you're ordering.
segments.zh: 我想这取决于你在哪里订购。
所以就是大号和中号披萨。

segments.en: Now let's take a look at some of the ingredients.
segments.zh: 现在让我们来看看一些成分。

segments.en: This is the common ingredient in all pizza.
segments.zh: 这是所有披萨的常见成分。

segments.en: A pizza is not a pizza unless it has pepperoni.
segments.zh: 披萨不是披萨，除非它有意大利辣香肠。

segments.en: So pepperoni is a sausage, right?
segments.zh: 所以意大利辣香肠是香肠，对吧？

segments.en: And they look like a- Like circles.
segments.zh: 它们看起来像——像一个个圆圈。

segments.en: Olives are little black or green balls.
segments.zh: 橄榄是黑色或绿色的小球。

segments.en: You can also find them in a martini.
segments.zh: 你也可以在马提尼酒中找到它们。

segments.en: It's very common for them to have...
It's very common to have an...
It's very common to have an olive in a martini.
segments.zh: 在马提尼酒中放橄榄是很常见的。

segments.en: And he also ordered extra cheese.
And he also ordered another strange ingredient for a pizza.
segments.zh: 他还点了另一种奇怪的披萨配料。

segments.en: So weird to put pineapple on a pizza.
segments.zh: 把菠萝放在披萨上真是太奇怪了。

segments.en: Many people like pineapple on their pizza.
segments.zh: 许多人喜欢披萨上的菠萝。

segments.en: And it kind of looks like a little palm tree at the top.
segments.zh: 它有点像顶部的一棵小棕榈树。

segments.en: Like, yeah, the top of a pineapple looks like a tree.
segments.zh: 就像，是的，菠萝的顶部看起来像一棵树。

segments.en: Now, the last description of a pizza.
segments.zh: 现在，最后一个披萨的描述。

segments.en: He ordered it with thin crust.
Now, we know thin is some...
segments.zh: 现在，我们知道 thin 是……

segments.en: It's the bread part of the pizza.
That's my favorite part of the pizza.
segments.zh: 这是我最喜欢的披萨部分。

segments.en: And I just, I really love that bread part.
segments.zh: 我只是，我真的很喜欢那个面包的部分。

segments.en: It's so important to a good pizza.
segments.zh: 这对一个好的披萨非常重要。

segments.en: Well, you know, they also have the crust filled with cheese.
segments.zh: 嗯，你知道，他们还有夹芝士的饼底。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue again and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一遍我们的对话，然后我们会回来多说一点。

segments.en: I'd like a medium pizza with pepperoni, olives, and extra cheese.
segments.zh: 我想要一个中等大小的披萨，里面有意大利辣香肠、橄榄和额外的奶酪。

segments.en: We have a two for one special on large pizzas.
segments.zh: 我们的大号披萨现在买一送一。

segments.en: Would you like a large pizza instead?
Would you like your second pizza to be the same as the first?
segments.zh: 你希望你的第二个披萨和第一个披萨一样吗？

segments.en: I'd like the second one with ham, pineapple, and green peppers.
segments.zh: 第二个我要加火腿、菠萝和青椒。

segments.en: Oh, and make it thin crust.
Your total is $21.50 and your order will arrive in 30 minutes or it's free.
segments.zh: 您的总额为 21.50 美元，您的订单将在 30 分钟内到达或免费送达。

segments.en: Now we have some really polite language that you could use possibly with customers or with clients.
segments.zh: 现在我们有一些非常礼貌的说法，你可以在接待顾客或客户时用。

segments.en: The first phrase we have, um, I think is my favorite.
segments.zh: 我们的第一个短语，嗯，我认为是我最喜欢的。

segments.en: This is the way that Marty answered the phone, right?
segments.zh: 这是马蒂接电话的方式，对吧？

segments.en: He said, this is Marty speaking.
Now why is this so important?
segments.zh: 现在为什么这这么重要？

segments.en: Because a lot of people, when they answer the phone say, I'm Erica.
segments.zh: 因为很多人，当他们接电话时说，我是埃里卡。

segments.en: Like hello, I'm Erica, which is not what English people say.
segments.zh: 就像你好，我是 Erica，这不是英国人所说的。
所以，伙计们，记住这一点。

segments.en: You'll sound really, really great when you use this on the phone.
segments.zh: 当你在手机上使用它时，你会听起来非常非常棒。

segments.en: Then you also mentioned a two for one special.
segments.zh: 然后你还提到了买一送一特惠。

segments.en: So that means you're getting two pizzas, right?
segments.zh: 所以这意味着你要买两个比萨饼，对吧？

segments.en: And a special is just a special promotion.
segments.zh: 而 special 就是一种特别的促销。
现在是一个非常简单的短语。

segments.en: Now this is a great way to offer something.
segments.zh: 现在这是提供某些东西的好方法。

segments.en: It's a more polite way of asking, do you want?
segments.zh: 这是一种更礼貌的提问方式，你想要吗？

segments.en: But it's less polite than would you like?
segments.zh: 但它不如“Would you like”那么礼貌。

segments.en: Whenever you offer something, would you like a cup of coffee?
segments.zh: 每当你提供东西时，你想要一杯咖啡吗？

segments.en: Would you like to sit down?
Let's listen to our dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back and talk about pizza from a pizza expert.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次听听我们的对话，然后我们会回来谈论比萨专家的披萨。
我想要一个中等大小的披萨。

segments.en: Would you like a medium pizza with pepperoni, olives and extra cheese?
segments.zh: 你想要一个中等大小的披萨，里面有意大利辣香肠、橄榄和额外的奶酪吗？

segments.en: We have a two for one special on large pizzas.
segments.zh: 我们的大号披萨现在买一送一。

segments.en: Would you like a large pizza instead?
Would you like your second pizza to be the same size as the first?
segments.zh: 您希望您的第二个披萨的大小与第一个相同吗？

segments.en: Make the second one with ham, pineapple and green peppers.
segments.zh: 第二个加火腿、菠萝和青椒。

segments.en: Oh, and make it thin crust.
Your total is 2150 and your order will arrive in 30 minutes or it's free.
segments.zh: 您的总额是 21.50 美元，30 分钟内送达，否则免费。

segments.en: All right, we're back and we are here with our pizza expert, who else but Marco from ItalianPod.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，我们和我们的披萨专家一起在这里，除了来自 ItalianPod 的 Marco 之外，还有谁。

segments.en: Well, we're talking about pizza today and we wanted to know what's your opinion since pizza comes from Italy, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们今天谈论的是比萨饼，我们想知道你的意见，因为披萨来自意大利，对吧？

segments.en: So, the problem with pizza is that, yes, it comes from Italy.
segments.zh: 所以，披萨的问题在于，是的，它来自意大利。

segments.en: Originated, the story goes, you know, the princess, the queen Margarita.
segments.zh: 起源于，故事是，你知道的，公主，玛格丽塔王后。

segments.en: But the problem is that now this confusion worldwide, pizza and pizza Hut, American pizza, Italian pizza, that is not the same thing.
segments.zh: 但问题是，现在全世界的这种混乱，比萨和必胜客、美式披萨、意大利比萨，这不是一回事。

segments.en: So, pizza hat is an Italian pizza.
segments.zh: 所以，必胜客算是意大利披萨吗？

segments.en: Italians, a little bit of, Italians make food, but they're not good at branding it.
segments.zh: 意大利人，有点，意大利人制作食物，但他们不擅长品牌化。

segments.en: Americans, they're very good at branding the food.
segments.zh: 美国人，他们非常擅长为食物打造品牌。

segments.en: So they have Starbucks and pizza hat and blah, blah, blah.
segments.zh: 所以他们有星巴克、必胜客，等等等等。

segments.en: The problem is that since they have to brand it, they don't change the name.
segments.zh: 问题是，由于他们必须品牌化，因此他们不会更改名称。

segments.en: So they do this pizza Hut that is totally different from Italian pizza.
segments.zh: 所以他们做这个与意大利比萨完全不同的必胜客。

segments.en: Have you ever seen the two of them?
Yeah, yeah, they are very different.
segments.zh: 是的，是的，它们非常不同。

segments.en: So, okay, can you put pineapple and ham on a pizza?
segments.zh: 那么，好吧，你能把菠萝和火腿放在披萨上吗？

segments.en: As long as you call it Hawaiian, you can put pineapple in everything, I guess.
segments.zh: 只要你叫它夏威夷风味，我猜你就可以往任何东西上加菠萝。

segments.en: But the problem, what I'm trying to say is that, okay, Italian pizza is, you know, you have the flour, the pasta, the crust, the tomato sauce, and then the mozzarella cheese, and that's the basic, and then you can build on top of it with some variations.
segments.zh: 但问题是，我想说的是，好吧，意大利比萨是，你知道，你有面粉、意大利面、外壳、番茄酱，然后是马苏里拉奶酪，这是最基本的，然后你可以在上面做一些变化。

segments.en: American pizza is basically take everything that you have on the table and put it on it.
segments.zh: 美国披萨基本上是把你桌子上的所有东西都放在上面。

segments.en: But I'm not saying I'm against American pizza.
segments.zh: 但我并不是说我反对美国披萨。

segments.en: I'm saying that you just should change the name to another thing.
segments.zh: 我是说你应该把名字改成另一个东西。

segments.en: What do you suggest we should call it?
segments.zh: 你建议我们应该怎么称呼它？

segments.en: But maybe you need like an A, like a Zipa.
segments.zh: 但也许你需要像 A 一样，像一个 Zipa。
A 点 Zipa 点 com。
给我来一份 A Zipa 好吗？

segments.en: So Margo, I know that you are very much against having Pizza Hut pizza.
segments.zh: 所以玛戈，我知道你非常反对吃必胜客披萨。

segments.en: I like it as an exotic experience because I like the fact that it's so much stuff in it that you cannot even tell the difference between the ingredients.
segments.zh: 我喜欢它作为一种异国情调的体验，因为我喜欢它里面有很多东西，你甚至无法分辨成分之间的区别。

segments.en: You know, they have the super mega supreme.
segments.zh: 你知道，他们有那种 super mega supreme（超级至尊）。

segments.en: I don't even know what's inside.
segments.zh: 我甚至不知道里面是什么。

segments.en: It's like there's a part in my mouth and everybody's invited.
segments.zh: 就像我嘴里办了个派对，所有人都被邀请了。

segments.en: That's for me the feeling of American pizza.
segments.zh: 这就是美国披萨的感觉。

segments.en: Another interesting thing when we were eating pizza with Marco is that he noticed the way that people from different countries eat pizza.
segments.zh: 当我们和 Marco 一起吃披萨时，另一个有趣的事情是他注意到来自不同国家的人们吃披萨的方式。
意大利人折叠他们的披萨。

segments.en: And another thing is that we have a whole pizza.
segments.zh: 另一件事是我们有一个完整的披萨。

segments.en: Like if I order one pizza, it's not like I share, everybody has one slice of it.
segments.zh: 就像我点了一份披萨，不像我分享，每个人都有一片。

segments.en: We order one pizza, you order your pizza, she order her pizza and so on.
segments.zh: 我们点了一份披萨，你点了你的披萨，她点了她的披萨等等。

segments.en: Don't mess with my pizza, Marco Zero.
segments.zh: 不要惹我的披萨，马可零。

segments.en: All right, well, this whole pizza discussion, let's see what our listeners have to say about it.
segments.zh: 好吧，好吧，整个披萨讨论，让我们看看我们的听众对此有何看法。

segments.en: I know that we have listeners from all over the world and what do they do with their pizzas?
segments.zh: 我知道我们有来自世界各地的听众，他们如何处理比萨饼？

segments.en: What do you like on your pizza?
For example, how high do you want the crust to be?
segments.zh: 例如，您希望地壳有多高？

segments.en: How thin you want your crust to be?
segments.zh: 你希望你的地壳有多薄？

segments.en: I know that, for example, in some countries they put ketchup on their pizza.
segments.zh: 例如，我知道在一些国家，他们在披萨上放了番茄酱。

segments.en: I know once I was eating, I had a Japanese friend who ordered a pizza from Pizza Hut and the pizza had the pineapple and other stuff on it and then she took out like ketchup and mayonnaise and she got like wild.
segments.zh: 我知道有一次我在吃东西，我有个日本朋友从必胜客点了份披萨，上面有菠萝和其他东西，然后她掏出番茄酱和蛋黄酱，简直像疯了一样。

segments.en: Although I must tell you, I like Tabasco on my pizza and I know that's wrong.
segments.zh: 不过我得告诉你，我喜欢在披萨上加塔巴斯科辣酱，我知道这样不对。

segments.en: You do what you have to do, Erika.
segments.zh: 你做你必须做的，埃里卡。

segments.en: And history will judge you for that.
We're out of time and before Marco has a heart attack or an aneurysm or something, we're making him angry here.
segments.zh: 我们已经没有时间了，在马可心脏病发作或动脉瘤或其他什么之前，我们在这里让他生气。

segments.en: And if you have any questions for us and also for Marco because I'm sure he's going to be commenting on this aspect.
segments.zh: 如果您对我们和 Marco 有任何疑问，因为我相信他会对这方面发表评论。

segments.en: So go to our comment section at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，请访问 englishpod.com 上的评论部分。

segments.en: And Marco and I, Marco Zero and I are always there to answer your questions.
segments.zh: 马可和我，马可零和我总是在那里回答你的问题。
